cathay.notes: cathaypacific.com FAQ: "Digital boarding passes are available from 48 hours up to 60 minutes before departure." HKG airport counters and self-service facilities close "punctually 60 minutes before scheduled departure". Cathay's agent site (cxagents.com) adds that online check-in opens 48 h before departure for Cathay members and 24 h for non-members, with a 60-min close (D-60) standardised from 25 Jun 2024 incl. HKG/TPE/KHH. No 90-minute online-check-in close for US flights was found; 90 min applies to in-town check-in. For US-bound flights, Cathay says TSA rules mean boarding passes can only be issued 24 h before departure.

inTown.hours: Kowloon Station: self-service check-in kiosks and bag drop daily 6:00am–3:00pm. Hong Kong Station: daily 6:00am–11:00pm.
inTown.window: Bag drop after online check-in from 24 hours up to 90 minutes before scheduled departure (Cathay). MTR: check-in as early as 24 h in advance and up to 90 min before departure, during service hours. Cathay FAQ: arrive at the in-town counter not less than 90 minutes before departure. Requires valid electronic travel documents and a valid Airport Express ticket. Max bag 145×100×85 cm; MTR also gives a 32 kg limit.
inTown.usFlights: Not stated as excluded. Under "Flights to the United States", Cathay's in-town section says only: "Due to TSA regulations, boarding passes for flights to the US can only be issued 24 hours before departure." In-town cannot handle infants, upgrades, excess-baggage redemption, extra-legroom seats, group/agency bookings or special services. For codeshare flights, go to the operating carrier's counters.
